name: Stage A multi-granularity compression
description: Context preparation for LLM detectors: summarises every step at three lengths (th1/th2/th3) and renders the trajectory graded by distance from the region under judgement, so detail is spent where the failure is instead of clipped uniformly. Two short-circuits skip the model for steps that are already short or machine-generated. Ported from TrajDebug Stage A (THU-KEG/TrajDebug, MIT).
